life-event.module.title: Life Event Module
life-event.module.description: Scenario-based guidance and action plans for major life changes in Germany
life-event.explorer.title: Explore life scenarios
life-event.explorer.description: Run a guided scenario for a specific life change. This is separate from your personalized plan above.
life-event.reasoning.secondary.housing_d: Housing details are incomplete for planning.

life-event.scenario.job_loss.reasoning: Losing employment shifts your situation toward economic setup — income, insurance, and benefits need reassessment.
life-event.scenario.new_arrival.reasonin: A recent arrival without completed registration places you in the unregistered arrival state.
life-event.scenario.housing_change.reaso: An active housing change or incomplete housing data moves your situation toward housing instability.
life-event.scenario.insurance_loss.reaso: Missing or lost health insurance coverage creates an insurance gap that needs immediate attention.
life-event.scenario.income_drop.reasonin: A significant income reduction signals that your economic setup may need to be revisited.
life-event.scenario.benefits_trigger.rea: Changes in employment or missing benefits data suggest exploring available support options.
life-event.scenario.stability_restore.re: Core situation signals are in place — your profile is trending toward a stable state.
life-event.runtime.signal.housingBenefit: Housing context updated — benefits tools may now be more relevant.
life-event.runtime.signal.registrationIn: Registration progress may unlock insurance guidance.
life-event.runtime.signal.insuranceSofte: Insurance update may soften economic setup pressure.
life-event.runtime.signal.insuranceFaile: Insurance step did not complete — economic setup may remain blocked.
life-event.runtime.signal.employmentStab: Employment or income update completed — situation may trend toward stability.
life-event.node.g1-secure-address.title: Secure a registrable address
life-event.node.g1-secure-address.descri: Confirm where you can legally register and obtain landlord confirmation if required.
life-event.node.g1-secure-address.ration: Anmeldung requires a valid address — housing and registration are coupled.
life-event.node.g1-complete-anmeldung.de: Book a Bürgeramt appointment and register your address within the legal deadline.
life-event.node.g1-complete-anmeldung.ra: Registration unlocks tax ID, insurance paths, and employment formalities.
life-event.node.g1-insurance-awareness.d: Learn your insurance obligation and begin enrollment if employment is not imminent.
life-event.node.g1-insurance-awareness.r: Health insurance is mandatory in Germany.
life-event.node.g1-banking-tax.title: Set up banking and tax path
life-event.node.g1-banking-tax.descripti: Open a bank account for rent and salary; expect your tax ID after registration.
life-event.node.g1-banking-tax.rationale: Financial infrastructure supports housing and employment next steps.
life-event.graph.arrival_stabilizing.int: Order early settlement across survival domains
Verify your Anmeldung and update your situation after any recent move.
Confirm foundation before stacking other settlement tasks.
life-event.node.g2-enroll-insurance.desc: Choose statutory or private coverage and complete Krankenkasse enrollment.
life-event.node.g2-enroll-insurance.rati: Mandatory coverage is the highest survival priority after registration.
life-event.node.g2-economic-path.title: Clarify employment and income path
life-event.node.g2-economic-path.descrip: Record employment status or start your job search with clear next steps.
life-event.node.g2-housing-banking.title: Confirm housing and banking
life-event.node.g2-housing-banking.descr: Record rent and housing details and open a suitable bank account.
life-event.node.g2-housing-banking.ratio: Physical and financial base for daily life.
life-event.node.g2-benefits-awareness.ti: Check if support programs may apply
life-event.node.g2-benefits-awareness.de: If income is low or uncertain, explore whether state support is relevant.
Register with Agentur für Arbeit if unemployed and clarify job search obligations.
Employment status drives insurance, benefits, and daily income.
Prevent or close a health insurance gap during your job transition.
Mandatory insurance must not lapse between jobs.
life-event.node.g3-income-clarity.title: Clarify income basis
life-event.node.g3-income-clarity.descri: Record or estimate income to support budgeting and benefits assessment.
life-event.node.g3-benefits-pathway.titl: Explore support if income is insufficient
life-event.node.g3-benefits-pathway.desc: Assess Bürgergeld, ALG I, or bridging support if income is not enough.
life-event.node.g3-benefits-pathway.rati: Support may be available after economic clarity.
life-event.node.g4-clarify-housing.title: Clarify your living situation
life-event.node.g4-clarify-housing.descr: Determine whether your current housing is temporary or long-term.
life-event.node.g4-clarify-housing.ratio: Admin planning requires a clear housing picture.
life-event.node.g4-secure-housing.title: Secure registrable housing
life-event.node.g4-secure-housing.descri: Find housing with a valid lease and landlord confirmation for registration.
life-event.node.g4-secure-housing.ration: A registrable address unlocks Anmeldung and benefits.
life-event.node.g4-register-address.desc: Complete Anmeldung or Ummeldung at your current address.
life-event.node.g4-register-address.rati: Legal address is required for most downstream admin.
life-event.node.g4-record-rent.title: Record rent and housing costs
life-event.node.g4-record-rent.descripti: Add rent details so benefits and budgeting estimates can be accurate.
life-event.node.g4-record-rent.rationale: Rent affects Wohngeld and affordability planning.
life-event.node.g5-assess-coverage.title: Assess your coverage status
life-event.node.g5-assess-coverage.descr: Determine whether you are currently insured and identify any gap.
life-event.node.g5-assess-coverage.ratio: You cannot close a gap without knowing it exists.
life-event.node.g5-choose-path.title: Choose your insurance path
life-event.node.g5-choose-path.descripti: Select the correct statutory or private path based on your status.
life-event.node.g5-choose-path.rationale: The enrollment path depends on employment and residency status.
life-event.node.g5-enroll-restore.title: Enroll or restore coverage
life-event.node.g5-enroll-restore.descri: Contact Krankenkasse and complete enrollment without leaving a gap.
life-event.node.g5-enroll-restore.ration: Mandatory coverage closes legal and financial risk.
life-event.node.g5-family-coverage.title: Confirm family coverage rules
life-event.node.g5-family-coverage.descr: If you have dependents, confirm how family insurance applies.
life-event.node.g5-family-coverage.ratio: Family members may need separate or joint coverage steps.
life-event.graph.benefits_exploration.in: Assess and navigate state support options
life-event.node.g6-complete-inputs.title: Complete assessment inputs
life-event.node.g6-complete-inputs.descr: Ensure income, rent, and household details are recorded.
life-event.node.g6-complete-inputs.ratio: Benefits estimates require complete situation inputs.
life-event.node.g6-identify-programs.des: Explore which of Bürgergeld, ALG I, Wohngeld, or Kindergeld may apply.
life-event.node.g6-identify-programs.rat: Programs have different gates — map options before acting.
life-event.node.g6-understand-obligation: Learn reporting duties and how part-time work interacts with support.
Support comes with rules the user should understand.
life-event.node.g6-application-path.desc: Identify the right office and documents for your situation.
life-event.node.g6-application-path.rati: Exploration becomes action when the user is ready to apply.
life-event.graph.situation_stable.intent: Maintain stability and prepare for life transitions
life-event.node.g7-review-foundation.tit: Review that your situation is current
life-event.node.g7-review-foundation.des: Confirm registration, insurance, work, and housing details are still accurate.
life-event.node.g7-life-transitions.desc: Explore guidance for job changes, moves, family events, or visa renewal.
life-event.node.g7-life-transitions.rati: Stable users benefit from proactive transition planning.
life-event.node.g7-optimization.title: Optimize finances and integration
life-event.node.g7-optimization.descript: Review tax class, language goals, or financial planning when ready.
